title: Al-Muqit: The Divine Name Built on the Word for a Day's Ration
excerpt: Al-Muqit occurs once in the Quran, and its root occurs only twice in the entire book. Al-Tabari records four early readings of the name and then chooses the one supported by a line of pre-Islamic verse.
seo_title: Al-Muqit: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Muqit appears once, at Quran 4:85. Its root appears only twice in the whole Quran. Al-Tabari's four readings, his verdict, and why "the Nourisher" is incomplete.
